name: Sisters In Power The Crown Is Ours
original_name: Sisters In Power The Crown Is Ours
overview:
Iris Losa, the true heiress of a wealthy family, was switched at birth. Upon her return, she discovers that the person who took her place is not her sister Marta, but Mario—her adoptive brother—whom her parents still regard as the heir.

Iris repeatedly thwarts Mario’s schemes and forges an unbreakable alliance with Marta. Together, they change their parents' perspective, reclaim their rightful inheritance, and take control of their own destinies.
